observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black console with a gold sticker on the top, placed on a dark, marbled surface.
Two white and black controllers are placed below the console, matching the console's design.
The console has a vertical slot on the right side, typical of PlayStation 5 models.
The controllers have a textured grip and a central button, consistent with PlayStation controllers.
There is a watermark 'SHOW GAMES' across the image.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: with complete accessories, 1 pad and 2 games inside
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the console and two controllers. No games, cables, or other accessories are visible. The claim of 'complete accessories' cannot be verified from the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, damaged, or not included as claimed
risks.proof: Photos of the two games and any included accessories (cables, chargers, etc.)

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit

proof_requests: Photo of the console's model label or serial number.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photos of the two games and any included accessories.
Video of both controllers connecting to the console and functioning.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
